attention4.ptxt: The ISG consists of precision parts. Without taking the following precautions, it may lose its original performance.

item.ptxt: Do not drop or expose the ISG to large shock.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect negative (–) cable at battery.
Hoist vehicle and remove engine undercover (if equipped) and right side engine under side cover.
Remove accessory drive belt.
For non-A/C model, remove accessory drive belt idler pulley and bracket.
For A/C model, with A/C hoses connected, detach A/C compressor from cylinder block, and disconnect magnet clutch lead wire connector.

attention4.ptxt: When A/C compressor is detached, the A/C hoses could be damaged receiving weight of the compressor.
Suspend the removed A/C compressor to the vehicle body while the compressor is detached.

s1.ptxt: Remove accessory drive belt lower tensioner.
Detach HO2S wire (1) from heat insulator (2), and remove the insulator from ISG.
Detach harness clamps (1).
Disconnect ISG connector (2) and “B” terminal wire (3).
Remove ISG bolt (upper side) (1).
Remove ISG bolt (lower side) (2) from rib on cylinder block.

attention3.ptxt: At this time, leave the bolt (lower side) on ISG.

s1.ptxt: Turning ISG (3) in arrow direction, remove it together with ISG bolt (lower side) passing the bolt through cutout (4) on oil pump assembly.
Remove ISG bracket (1), if necessary.
Remove harness bracket (1), if necessary.
Touch harness bracket stopper (1) to ISG and tighten its bolt (2) to specified torque.
Tighten ISG bracket bolts (1), if removed.
Install ISG (1) as follows.

s2.ptxt: With new ISG bolt (lower side) (1) inserted halfway, put ISG (2) on cylinder block passing the bolt through cutout (3) and tighten the bolt temporarily.
Turn ISG in arrow direction and tighten new ISG bolt (upper side) (4) temporarily.
Tighten ISG bolts (1) to 30 N·m (3.1 kgf-m, 22.5 lbf-ft) and check that bushings (2) are in contact with ISG bracket and cylinder block, and then loosen the bolts.
Tighten ISG bolts in numerical order (“1” – “2”) to specified torque.

s1.ptxt: Insert lugs (1) of “B” terminal wire (2) into grooves (3) and tighten “B” terminal nut (4) to specified torque.
Fit harness clamps (5) and connect ISG connector (6).
Install accessory drive belt lower tensioner.
For non-A/C model, install accessory drive belt idler pulley and bracket.
For A/C model, install A/C compressor to cylinder block, and connect magnet clutch lead wire connector.
Install accessory drive belt.
Install engine undercover (if equipped) and right side engine under side cover.
Connect negative (–) cable at battery.
